confidence_notes: Holistic general-knowledge estimate for a small surf town; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are moderate confidence. Accommodation is least certain because prices vary widely by season, beachfront location and room type. Beer is set at about 2.50 USD for a 330 ml serving, a bottle-equivalent since draft beer is rare locally. Cocktail is set at about 2x beer. Wine glass is set at about 2.8x beer, reflecting the high import and alcohol taxes on wine in Sri Lanka. The FX value comes from a search-result summary of the RBA homepage (4.00pm, 14 October 2026) that I did not open or verify directly; a third-party site listed 0.6979 for 9 October 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: South Asia basis, using Sri Lankan beach and surf tourism towns such as Mirissa and Unawatuna as reference points, adjusted for Arugam Bay's smaller size and July peak-season demand.
